name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta province, Argentina. The project hosts a large silver-gold resource of approximately 213 Moz silver equivalent and is advancing toward a feasibility study with a construction decision targeted in the second half of 2026. The company also holds an option on the La Coipita project in San Juan province and received RIGI investment regime approval for Diablillos in early 2026.
